title: Process Coordinator - Fresher
description:
Role & responsibilities Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Support the Operations Manager with daily activities, follow-ups, and operational tasks. Prepare, update, and maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports. Collect, consolidate, and verify data from various departments. Track daily activities, pending tasks, and process updates to ensure timely completion. Follow up with team members and departments regarding reports, deliverables, and deadlines. Maintain accurate records, documentation, and operational data. Monitor work progress and escalate delays or issues to the concerned manager. Assist in preparing MIS reports and maintaining Excel-based trackers. Perform other operational and coordination tasks as assigned by the manager.

Key Skills: Communication skills,Reporting,Excel,Microsoft,Process
